name: Ryanondocin2019/Disease-predictions-deep-learning-ML
description: This project will serve as an anthology for all superivised learning algoithms we have covered throughout the course of this semester in Data Analytics. Multiple ML algaoritms/Deep Neural Nets will be deployed and tuned/experimented with in order to deal with the binary classification problem of diagnosing a patient with a certain, unspecified disease. The primary focus of this work will be to tune and compare more advanced algorithms such as multilayer-perceptron ANN's to simpler, less computationally expensive shallow algorithms that we have dealt with in previous works.
